title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings: reproducibility artifact
description: Reproducibility repository for When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings. Release 1.2.0 adds a label-limited audit example, isolated verification/reproduction/build commands, pinned runtime dependencies, traceable documentation and continuous integration. The V4 manuscript, frozen inputs, scientific code and numeric results are unchanged from artifact 1.1.0. Prepared for ESANN 2027 general track; not an acceptance or completed-submission claim. Current public access and citation use the versioned GitHub release; no DOI is assigned to 1.2.0. Software BSD-3-Clause, manuscript CC BY 4.0, original template license retained.
